products.title: Gel Mix Flask 350ml
products.body_html:
Gel Mix Flask 350 ml is a soft flask made specifically for fueling with Gel Mix 480 when training or racing. Designed to be carried in a running vest, waist belt, or back pocket. Equipped with a SpeedFill™ cap for fast refills and a bite valve for fueling easily over challenging terrain.

 

Hydrogel for miles. And days.

A fueling solution that enables you to carry up to 120g of carbohydrates in your pocket. The bite valve simplifies consumption on the move — on gravel, trails, or mid-race when not wanting to stop. The SpeedFill™ cap makes refills fast by easily popping the cap open. Compatible with the Gel Mix 480 sachet — the opening is designed to fit directly into the top of the flask. Compact enough for a vest pocket, waist belt, or back pocket.

How to prepare with Gel Mix Flask 350 ml

1.     Fill flask to the line with 200 ml of water.

2.     If wanting to personalize taste, add preferred Addition first and shake.

3.     Pour in Gel Mix 480 from sachet.

4.     Shake flask vigorously again until dissolved.

5.     Let the mix rest for 5 minutes before consuming.

 

Volume 350 ml

Opening Type SpeedFill™ screw cap with bite valve

Carry options Running vest, waist belt, back pocket

Compatible with Gel Mix 480

Other details Food product approved. Wash before first use.

products.title: Gel Mix 480 - Box of 6 servings
products.body_html:
Maurten Gel Mix 480 is a carbohydrate fuel for endurance sport based on Hydrogel Technology. It contains 120 grams of carbohydrates when combined with 200 ml of water. A different hydrogel fuelling format with a texture thicker than Drink Mix and looser than the Gel — Gel Mix 480 can be adjusted to personal taste by combining with Additions.

Designed for fuelling with Gel Mix Flask 350 ml to carry in a running vest, waist belt, or back pocket — equipped with a SpeedFill™ cap for fast refills and a bite valve to consume easily.

Limited Offer

Purchase of a Gel Mix box gives you 40% off Gel Mix Flask 350 ml and 1 free box of Additions

A new consistency.  
Gel Mix 480 gives athletes more access to training and racing with Hydrogel Technology. A flask-driven fuelling system for athletes exercising with intent — the duration and distance of a long session or race, the frequency of a sustained training block. Because consistency matters, Gel Mix 480 offers an additional hydrogel fuelling format to ensure that more sessions and races are fuelled fully. The texture is thicker than Drink Mix and looser than the Gel. Each sachet contains 120 grams of carbohydrates when dissolved in 200 ml of water.    

Gel Mix 480 is pH-sensitive. It behaves like Drink Mix, becoming a true gel in the acidity of the stomach. This change encapsulates the carbohydrates, carrying them through the stomach to be absorbed, making fuelling for sports easier.

Take it personally.  
Gel Mix 480 contains no added flavour, preservatives, or colour. For texture variation, and to overcome the limitation of flavour fatigue, it can be combined with Maurten Additions — Cola, Menthol, Orange, or Apple. Gel Mix 480 is designed to be mixed and consumed with Gel Mix Flask 350 ml and can be stored in a fridge for up to 72 hours.  

Hydrogel for miles. And days.
Over longer duration and longer distance, the more your body will depend on the fuel you consume. Gel Mix 480 is for the efforts that demand more — the weeks that demand consistency. 120 grams of carbohydrates per sachet gives athletes greater fuelling support, flexibility, and control.  

 

Flask-driven fuelling system
Gel Mix 480 is designed to be used with Gel Mix Flask 350 ml. The soft flask is equipped with a SpeedFill™ cap for fast refills, a 200 ml fill line for water, and a bite valve for fuelling easily over challenging terrain. Made to fit in a running vest, waist belt, or back pocket. Other soft flasks or bottles can be used with Gel Mix 480 but are not optimal — see FAQ for more information.

 

How to prepare with Gel Mix Flask 350 ml

  1. Fill flask to the line with 200 ml of water.
  2. If wanting to personalise taste, add preferred Addition first and shake.
  3. Pour in Gel Mix 480 from sachet.
  4. Shake flask vigorously again until dissolved.
  5. Let the mix rest for 5 minutes before consuming.

products.title: Addition
products.body_html:
Maurten Addition is a solution for overcoming flavor fatigue during training or racing. Reset the palate by adding 1 serving to 500 ml of Drink Mix 320 or 160. Choose between Apple, Cola, Menthol, or Orange. Compatible with Maurten Hydrogel Technology products.

Limited time — 1 x box of Additions included with every Drink Mix purchase. 

Add taste to the Mix 
Maurten Addition is a palate reset. It is designed to give athletes the option of adding a different taste to Drink Mix 320 or 160. Repeated consumption of carbohydrate fuels — even those with a neutral flavor profile — can lead to a state of flavor fatigue. Symptoms can include a lack of motivation to maintain a planned fueling protocol, sickly or nauseous sensation, and a desensitized sense of taste. For athletes impacted by flavor fatigue, the result can be reduced fueling and an energy deficit. Maurten Addition enables athletes to vary their fuel according to preferred taste without impacting the function of Hydrogel Technology.

Taste is personal
Any fuel strategy should be unique to the athlete using it. Taste is no different. How and when athletes use taste is highly individualized. Additions enable athletes to vary the taste of Drink Mix on their terms — applying a palate reset where necessary and as required. This is calculated fueling. 

Flavor fatigue explained 
Over-exposure and repeated consumption of the same taste or texture can reduce the appetite to maintain a consistent fueling strategy. In short, fuel becomes less appealing. It breaks an athlete’s commitment to the plan they are trying to follow and ultimately may lead to an energy deficit. Additions help athletes to prioritize fueling by mitigating against the negative effects of flavor fatigue.

Maurten Gel and Drink Mix — based on Hydrogel Technology — have fueled the fastest marathon times in history.

products.body_html:
This is the Maurten Run Training Collection — a 4-week solution that fuels the initial block of marathon training. Each pack includes: 10x Gel 100, 2x Gel 100 Caf 100, 4x Drink Mix 160, 4x Solid 160, and a 500ml bottle.

This Collection — designed by the Maurten Nutrition Team — fuels the first 4 weeks of a typical marathon training plan. After which, the Maurten Marathon Training Collection takes you the rest of the way to race day.  

The Maurten Run Training Collection should be used during intentional workouts (tempo sessions or long runs) to help the body with the process of adapting to, and tolerating, the consumption of carbohydrates while running.

Sports fuels are specifically designed to reduce the workload on your digestive system during high-intensity training, when blood is diverted to working muscles. In these specific sessions it’s appropriate to continue using high-carbohydrate fuel.   

You don’t need to fuel every workout. In sessions with a relatively low target heart rate, where the effort may be described as conversational, the demand for high-carbohydrate intake is reduced.
